cases.given: The team has fixated on the new database query although saturation and cache invalidation are also plausible.
cases.expect: A bounded, evidence-selected diagnosis with one residual uncertainty noted.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the answer is directly established by a locked source
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: If a hard veto eliminates a branch, do not keep it alive for balance.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: explicitly test at least one plausible rival before a costly commitment

cases.given: A draft commits to the first plausible cause in an ambiguous incident.
cases.expect: The skill names a materially different rival and a decisive evidence check before commitment.
cases.reject: The skill merely says to think broadly or produces an unbounded brainstorm.
